comment: Catalog ids whose native/browser model and CARLA blueprint are NOT the same source model. Every other catalog id must resolve to the same model in both renderers (carla-blueprints.json vs studio/app/generated/carla-object-catalog.json equivalents); packages/asset-catalog/src/__tests__/renderer-parity.test.ts enforces this table both ways. `carla: null` = CARLA fails closed (unavailable); `native: null` = the procedural builder draws it natively.

vehicle.shuttle_bus.reason: CARLA has no shuttle body and the Sprinter is not bound for this id; native shows a long-wheelbase Sprinter.

vehicle.bus.reason: The only CARLA bus body (Fuso Rosa, 10.2 m) fails the dimension gate for a 12.2 m bus, so CARLA fails closed.

vehicle.kia.carnival.reason: The Kia Carnival is not in the converted native pack; native shows the BMW minivan silhouette.

vehicle.tesla_model_3.reason: CARLA 0.10 has no Model 3 blueprint (the native model is a static mesh from the content pack).

vehicle.jeep_wrangler.reason: CARLA 0.10 has no Wrangler blueprint (the native model comes from the content pack).

vehicle.police_suv.reason: No CARLA police SUV: native draws the procedural police SUV builder, CARLA the police Charger.

vehicle.porsche_911.reason: No usable 911 counterpart in either pack: native keeps its procedural builder, CARLA the Charger.
